Fee Rules: Fees must be paid in one installment within two weeks of the 1st Semester in the College. Fine: ₹20/day for delayed payment up to 2 weeks. After 2 weeks, the student's name will be deleted from the rolls. Readmission fee: ₹500 in addition to fine dues. Fees once paid are non-refundable. Non-payment of fees will result in forfeiture of the seat.
